mapper.select: SELECT etf_code, max(snapshot_date) AS snapshot_date, NULL AS raw_code, NULL AS ticker, NULL AS stock_name, NULL AS day_chg_pct FROM holdings_etf GROUP BY etf_code ORDER BY etf_code

SELECT h.etf_code, h.snapshot_date, h.raw_code, h.ticker, h.stock_name, h.day_chg_pct FROM holdings_etf h JOIN (SELECT etf_code, max(snapshot_date) AS d FROM holdings_etf GROUP BY etf_code) l ON l.etf_code = h.etf_code AND l.d = h.snapshot_date WHERE h.day_chg_pct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY h.etf_code, h.raw_code
